verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is a hardware AI accelerator (a PCIe/OAM card with a software stack for training and inference), not an interactive application that could host a built-in assistant, so this story is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the product or its software ships any built-in AI assistant that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
